  • Weekly Org Report (2026-09-28..2026-10-04) — eunomia-bpf/eunomia.dev #215 (Open)
  • process probe: scope to another container's PID namespace or cgroup from a sidecar; PROBE_LIVENESS arrives as runner_parse_error — eunomia-bpf/agentsight #236 (Open)
  • process probe FILE_OPEN: dev_maj_min decodes the kernel dev_t with userspace major()/minor() — eunomia-bpf/agentsight #235 (Open)
  • Complete process probe liveness, file paths, and listener fields — eunomia-bpf/agentsight #234 (Closed)
  • process probe --trace-net: NET_LISTEN has no address/port, so kernel-chosen and IPv6 listeners are unidentified — eunomia-bpf/agentsight #233 (Closed)
